parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters); a retry reuses it. The same key with the same request (method, path, body) replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true. A 2xx is stored for 24 hours, and so is a refusal that is final for the request (malformed-request, allocation-mismatch, negative-amount); a refusal that depends on state that can change (not-found, concurrent-update, illegal-transition, over-refund, payment-declined, validation-failed) and a 5xx are not stored: the key is released and the same key runs the request again, and another request under a released key is a new request. The same key with another request while an answer is stored is 409 idempotency-key-reused. Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required, not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters is 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
